entities.name: Zalgadib
entities.description: A Tempest Efreet from Suq'Ata who defended Ramses Overdark's keep and was killed by Kolo Meha.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Owner of the keep Zalgadib defended; died before the contract ended.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Killed Zalgadib on Tetsuo Umezawa's orders.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Sent Kolo Meha to destroy Overdark's keep.

events.summary: Ramses Overdark dies 256 years before the end of Zalgadib's contract.
events.quote: Ramses died 256 years before Zalgadib's contract to service to the keep ended
Zalgadib himself was killed by Kolo Meha
